def handle_shutdown_signal(signum, frame):
    sig_name = "SIGTERM" if signum == signal.SIGTERM else "SIGINT"
    print(f"\n[shutdown] Caught signal {sig_name} (PID {os.getpid()}). Flushing and alerting...", flush=True)
    send_ntfy(
        f"KPMS Tandem Run Interrupted ({sig_name})",
        f"Process caught {sig_name}. Checkpoint was saved on last 25-iter boundary. Resuming this script will continue from the latest checkpoint.",
        priority="high",
        tags="warning,pause"
    )
    sys.exit(128 + signum)

signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, handle_shutdown_signal)
signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, handle_shutdown_signal)


def fuse_full_session(top_h5_path, bot_h5_path, out_h5_path, fixed_scale=0.3716):
    """Generates fused 23-keypoint reflection-corrected DataFrame if not already present."""
    if out_h5_path.exists():
        print(f"  • Using existing fused H5: {out_h5_path.name}", flush=True)
        return out_h5_path, fixed_scale

    print(f"  • Generating fused H5: {out_h5_path.name}...", flush=True)
    df_top = pd.read_hdf(top_h5_path)
    df_bot = pd.read_hdf(bot_h5_path)

    top_scorer = df_top.columns.levels[0][0]
    bot_scorer = df_bot.columns.levels[0][0]

    n_frames = min(len(df_top), len(df_bot))
    active_slice = slice(0, n_frames)

    top_nx = df_top[top_scorer, "nose", "x"].iloc[active_slice].to_numpy(dtype=float)
    top_ny = df_top[top_scorer, "nose", "y"].iloc[active_slice].to_numpy(dtype=float)
    top_tx = df_top[top_scorer, "tail_base", "x"].iloc[active_slice].to_numpy(dtype=float)
    top_ty = df_top[top_scorer, "tail_base", "y"].iloc[active_slice].to_numpy(dtype=float)

    c_top = np.column_stack([0.5 * (top_nx + top_tx), 0.5 * (top_ny + top_ty)])
    c_top_smooth = median_filter(c_top, size=(11, 1), mode="nearest")

    theta_top = np.arctan2(top_ny - top_ty, top_nx - top_tx)
    cos_smooth = median_filter(np.cos(theta_top), size=11, mode="nearest")
    sin_smooth = median_filter(np.sin(theta_top), size=11, mode="nearest")
    theta_top_smooth = np.arctan2(sin_smooth, cos_smooth)

    bot_raw = {}
    for bp in ["left_front_paw", "right_front_paw", "left_hind_paw", "right_hind_paw", "nose_tip", "tail_base"]:
        bot_raw[bp] = {
            "x": df_bot[bot_scorer, bp, "x"].iloc[active_slice].to_numpy(dtype=float),
            "y": df_bot[bot_scorer, bp, "y"].iloc[active_slice].to_numpy(dtype=float),
            "p": df_bot[bot_scorer, bp, "likelihood"].iloc[active_slice].to_numpy(dtype=float)
        }

    bot_transformed = {}
    for bp in ["left_front_paw", "right_front_paw", "left_hind_paw", "right_hind_paw", "bot_nose_tip", "bot_tail_base"]:
        orig_key = "nose_tip" if bp == "bot_nose_tip" else ("tail_base" if bp == "bot_tail_base" else bp)
        coords = bot_raw[orig_key]

        x_refl = 972.0 - coords["x"]
        y_refl = coords["y"]

        bot_nx_r = 972.0 - bot_raw["nose_tip"]["x"]
        bot_ny_r = bot_raw["nose_tip"]["y"]
        bot_tx_r = 972.0 - bot_raw["tail_base"]["x"]
        bot_ty_r = bot_raw["tail_base"]["y"]

        c_bot_r = np.column_stack([0.5 * (bot_nx_r + bot_tx_r), 0.5 * (bot_ny_r + bot_ty_r)])
        c_bot_r_smooth = median_filter(c_bot_r, size=(11, 1), mode="nearest")

        theta_bot_r = np.arctan2(bot_ny_r - bot_ty_r, bot_nx_r - bot_tx_r)
        cos_b = median_filter(np.cos(theta_bot_r), size=11, mode="nearest")
        sin_b = median_filter(np.sin(theta_bot_r), size=11, mode="nearest")
        theta_bot_r_smooth = np.arctan2(sin_b, cos_b)

        p_rel_bot = np.column_stack([x_refl - c_bot_r_smooth[:, 0], y_refl - c_bot_r_smooth[:, 1]])

        cos_rel = np.cos(-theta_bot_r_smooth)
        sin_rel = np.sin(-theta_bot_r_smooth)
        p_ego_x = p_rel_bot[:, 0] * cos_rel - p_rel_bot[:, 1] * sin_rel
        p_ego_y = p_rel_bot[:, 0] * sin_rel + p_rel_bot[:, 1] * cos_rel

        p_ego_scaled = np.column_stack([p_ego_x * fixed_scale, p_ego_y * fixed_scale])

        cos_top = np.cos(theta_top_smooth)
        sin_top = np.sin(theta_top_smooth)
        p_top_x = p_ego_scaled[:, 0] * cos_top - p_ego_scaled[:, 1] * sin_top
        p_top_y = p_ego_scaled[:, 0] * sin_top + p_ego_scaled[:, 1] * cos_top

        p_virtual_top = np.column_stack([p_top_x + c_top_smooth[:, 0], p_top_y + c_top_smooth[:, 1]])

        bot_transformed[bp] = {
            "x": p_virtual_top[:, 0],
            "y": p_virtual_top[:, 1],
            "p": coords["p"]
        }

    fused_scorer = "Tandem_Dorsal_Ventral_Fused"
    columns_tuples = []
    columns_data = {}

    for bp in TOP_USE_BODYPARTS:
        columns_tuples.extend([(fused_scorer, bp, "x"), (fused_scorer, bp, "y"), (fused_scorer, bp, "likelihood")])
        columns_data[(fused_scorer, bp, "x")] = df_top[top_scorer, bp, "x"].iloc[active_slice].to_numpy(dtype=np.float32)
        columns_data[(fused_scorer, bp, "y")] = df_top[top_scorer, bp, "y"].iloc[active_slice].to_numpy(dtype=np.float32)
        columns_data[(fused_scorer, bp, "likelihood")] = df_top[top_scorer, bp, "likelihood"].iloc[active_slice].to_numpy(dtype=np.float32)

    for bp in ["left_front_paw", "right_front_paw", "left_hind_paw", "right_hind_paw", "bot_nose_tip", "bot_tail_base"]:
        columns_tuples.extend([(fused_scorer, bp, "x"), (fused_scorer, bp, "y"), (fused_scorer, bp, "likelihood")])
        columns_data[(fused_scorer, bp, "x")] = bot_transformed[bp]["x"].astype(np.float32)
        columns_data[(fused_scorer, bp, "y")] = bot_transformed[bp]["y"].astype(np.float32)
        columns_data[(fused_scorer, bp, "likelihood")] = bot_transformed[bp]["p"].astype(np.float32)

    fused_index = pd.MultiIndex.from_tuples(columns_tuples, names=["scorer", "bodyparts", "coords"])
    df_fused = pd.DataFrame(columns_data, columns=fused_index)

    out_h5_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    df_fused.to_hdf(out_h5_path, key="df_with_missing", mode="w")
    print(f"  --> Fused H5 created: {out_h5_path.name} ({len(df_fused):,} frames, {len(df_fused.columns)//3} keypoints)", flush=True)
    return out_h5_path, fixed_scale


def main():
    import argparse
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Tandem KPMS Production Training")
    parser.add_argument("--init-kappa", type=float, default=INIT_KAPPA, help="Initial Kappa for AR phase")
    parser.add_argument("--decrease-kappa-factor", type=float, default=DECREASE_KAPPA_FACTOR, help="Reduction factor for SLDS phase")
    parser.add_argument("--num-ar-iters", type=int, default=NUM_AR_ITERS, help="Number of AR iters")
    parser.add_argument("--num-slds-iters", type=int, default=NUM_SLDS_ITERS, help="Number of SLDS iters")
    parser.add_argument("--save-every-n-iters", type=int, default=SAVE_EVERY_N_ITERS, help="Checkpoint save interval")
    parser.add_argument("--model-name", type=str, default=MODEL_NAME, help="Model name")
    parser.add_argument("--output-pkl", type=str, default=str(OUTPUT_PROD_PKL), help="Target output pickle path")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    init_kappa = args.init_kappa
    decrease_kappa_factor = args.decrease_kappa_factor
    slds_kappa = init_kappa / decrease_kappa_factor
    num_ar_iters = args.num_ar_iters
    num_slds_iters = args.num_slds_iters
    total_iters = num_ar_iters + num_slds_iters
    save_every_n_iters = args.save_every_n_iters
    model_name = args.model_name
    output_prod_pkl = Path(args.output_pkl)

    t_program_start = time.time()
    pid = os.getpid()

    print("=" * 80, flush=True)
    print(f"  TANDEM KPMS PRODUCTION RUN: {num_ar_iters} AR + {num_slds_iters} SLDS ({total_iters} TOTAL ITERS)", flush=True)
    print(f"  Date & Time:         {datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')}", flush=True)
    print(f"  Process PID:         {pid}", flush=True)
    print(f"  Model Name:          {model_name}", flush=True)
    print("  Hardware:            RTX 4090 (24.5 GB VRAM) with Amdahl 27x Optimizations", flush=True)
    print(f"  AR Iterations:       {num_ar_iters}", flush=True)
    print(f"  SLDS Iterations:     {num_slds_iters} (Total: {total_iters})", flush=True)
    print(f"  Init Kappa:          {init_kappa:.2e} (SLDS Kappa: {slds_kappa:.2e})", flush=True)
    print(f"  Checkpoint Interval: Every {save_every_n_iters} iterations", flush=True)
    print(f"  Project Directory:   {PROD_KPMS_DIR}", flush=True)
    print(f"  Target Pickle:       {output_prod_pkl}", flush=True)
    print("=" * 80, flush=True)

    # 1. Apply high-performance kernels
    print("\n[Step 1/6] Applying Amdahl 27x Optimizations (Banded Cholesky + GPU Kernels)...", flush=True)
    rb.apply_optimizations()

    # Send launch notification
    send_ntfy(
        f"KPMS Tandem Started ({model_name})",
        f"PID: {pid}\n"
        f"Plan: {num_ar_iters} AR + {num_slds_iters} SLDS = {total_iters} iters\n"
        f"Checkpoints every {save_every_n_iters} iters\n"
        f"Kappa: {init_kappa:.2e} -> {slds_kappa:.2e}\n"
        f"Tandem sessions: 2 full sessions (416,032 frames @ 60 FPS)",
        priority="default",
        tags="rocket,brain"
    )

    # 2. Ingest Base Sessions & Enrich
    print("\n[Step 2/6] Loading base SessionRecord objects and enriching references...", flush=True)
    with open(DIRTY_PKL_IN, "rb") as f:
        dirty_sessions = pickle.load(f)

    selected_sessions = [copy.deepcopy(s) for s in dirty_sessions if s.session_id in target_sids]
    selected_sessions.sort(key=lambda s: target_sids.index(s.session_id))
    assert len(selected_sessions) == 2, f"Could not find both target sessions in {DIRTY_PKL_IN}!"

    for s in selected_sessions:
        cfg = session_configs[s.session_id]
        fuse_full_session(cfg["top_h5"], cfg["bot_h5"], cfg["fused_h5"])

        # Video refs enrichment
        v_df = s.video_refs_df.copy()
        if not (v_df["role"] == "ventral").any():
            ventral_vid_row = {
                "path": str(cfg["bot_vid"]),
                "path_type": "video",
                "kind": "avi",
                "role": "ventral",
                "ts": s.metadata.get("timestamp"),
                "chamber": s.metadata.get("chamber"),
                "camset": "BotCamVid",
                "cam_slot": "bottom_cam",
                "arena": cfg["arena"],
                "camera_key": f"bottom_cam:{s.metadata.get('chamber')}",
                "fps": 60.0,
                "n_frames": 208016,
                "duration_s": 208016 / 60.0,
                "meta_origin": "opencv"
            }
            v_df = pd.concat([v_df, pd.DataFrame([ventral_vid_row])], ignore_index=True)
        s.video_refs_df = v_df

        # Tracking refs enrichment
        t_df = s.tracking_refs_df.copy()
        if not (t_df["role"] == "ventral").any():
            ventral_track_row = {
                "path": str(cfg["bot_h5"]),
                "path_type": "tracking",
                "kind": "h5",
                "role": "ventral",
                "camset": "BotCamVid",
                "cam_slot": "bottom_cam",
                "arena": cfg["arena"],
                "chamber": s.metadata.get("chamber"),
                "ts": s.metadata.get("timestamp"),
                "camera_key": f"bottom_cam:{s.metadata.get('chamber')}",
                "chamber_index": s.metadata.get("chamber_index", 0)
            }
            t_df = pd.concat([t_df, pd.DataFrame([ventral_track_row])], ignore_index=True)

        if not (t_df["role"] == "fused_23kp").any():
            fused_track_row = {
                "path": str(cfg["fused_h5"]),
                "path_type": "tracking",
                "kind": "h5",
                "role": "fused_23kp",
                "camset": "TandemMultiview",
                "cam_slot": "multiview_fused",
                "arena": cfg["arena"],
                "chamber": s.metadata.get("chamber"),
                "ts": s.metadata.get("timestamp"),
                "camera_key": f"multiview_fused:{s.metadata.get('chamber')}",
                "chamber_index": s.metadata.get("chamber_index", 0)
            }
            t_df = pd.concat([t_df, pd.DataFrame([fused_track_row])], ignore_index=True)
        s.tracking_refs_df = t_df

    # 3. Setup KPMS Project & Data Directory
    print("\n[Step 3/6] Setting up KPMS production project environment...", flush=True)
    PROD_DATA_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for sid, cfg in session_configs.items():
        src = cfg["fused_h5"]
        dst = PROD_DATA_DIR / f"{sid}_tandem_23kp.h5"
        if not dst.exists():
            dst.symlink_to(src)

    config_source = EXPERIMENT_DIR / "multiview_kappa_search/project/config.yml"
    config_dest = PROD_KPMS_DIR / "config.yml"
    if not config_dest.exists():
        shutil.copy(config_source, config_dest)

    config = kpms.load_config(str(PROD_KPMS_DIR))
    config["fps"] = TARGET_FPS
    config["trans_hypparams"]["kappa"] = init_kappa
    kpms.update_config(str(PROD_KPMS_DIR), **config)

    print("  Loading 23-keypoint tracking data into KPMS format...", flush=True)
    coordinates, confidences, bodyparts = kpms.load_keypoints(str(PROD_DATA_DIR), format="deeplabcut")
    data, metadata = kpms.format_data(coordinates, confidences, **config)
    data = convert_data_precision(data, np.float64)
    data["Y"] = np.asarray(data["Y"])

    # Load or fit PCA
    pca_p = PROD_KPMS_DIR / "pca.p"
    pca_asdf = PROD_KPMS_DIR / "pca.asdf"
    if pca_p.exists() or pca_asdf.exists():
        pca = kpms.load_pca(str(PROD_KPMS_DIR))
        print("  Loaded existing PCA from project.", flush=True)
    else:
        print("  Fitting and saving PCA...", flush=True)
        pca = kpms.fit_pca(**data, **config)
        kpms.save_pca(pca, str(PROD_KPMS_DIR))

    # Preemptive Analytical Batch Sizing
    print("  Executing Preemptive Analytical Tensor Sizing...", flush=True)
    rb.KPMSStateCache.clear()
    rb.precompute_optimal_batch_config(data, verbose=True)

    # 4. Checkpoint Resumption or Clean Initialization
    checkpoint_file = PROD_KPMS_DIR / model_name / "checkpoint.h5"
    current_iter = 0
    model = None

    if checkpoint_file.exists():
        try:
            print(f"\n  [RESUME] Found existing checkpoint at {checkpoint_file}. Resuming...", flush=True)
            model, data, metadata, current_iter = kpms.load_checkpoint(str(PROD_KPMS_DIR), model_name)
            data = convert_data_precision(data, np.float64)
            data["Y"] = np.asarray(data["Y"])
            rb.KPMSStateCache.clear()
            rb.precompute_optimal_batch_config(data, model=model, verbose=True)
            print(f"  [RESUME] Resumed successfully from iteration {current_iter}.", flush=True)
            send_ntfy(
                "KPMS Resumed from Checkpoint",
                f"Resumed training '{model_name}' at iteration {current_iter}/{total_iters}.",
                priority="default",
                tags="play,brain"
            )
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"  [warning] Failed to load checkpoint ({e}). Initializing fresh model...", flush=True)
            model = None
            current_iter = 0

    if model is None:
        print("\n  [INIT] Initializing fresh AR-HMM model with batched init...", flush=True)
        init_bs = min(rb.CONFIG.discrete_bs, 20)
        rng_key = jax.random.PRNGKey(42)
        model = batched_init_model_by_video(
            data, pca, config,
            params_subset_size=5, batch_size=init_bs, seed=rng_key
        )
        model = kpms.update_hypparams(model, kappa=float(init_kappa))
        current_iter = 0
        print("  [INIT] Initialization complete.", flush=True)

    # 5. Model Fitting Loop
    print(f"\n[Step 4/6] Executing KPMS Training Loop ({num_ar_iters} AR + {num_slds_iters} SLDS)...", flush=True)

    # PHASE 1: AR-ONLY FITTING (0 -> 50)
    if current_iter < num_ar_iters:
        print("\n" + "=" * 70, flush=True)
        print(f"  PHASE 1: AR-Only Fitting (iter {current_iter} -> {num_ar_iters})", flush=True)
        print(f"  Kappa: {init_kappa:.2e}", flush=True)
        print("=" * 70, flush=True)

        ar_start_wall = time.time()
        chunk_size = save_every_n_iters

        while current_iter < num_ar_iters:
            next_target = min(current_iter + chunk_size, num_ar_iters)
            chunk_t0 = time.time()
            print(f"\n>>> Running AR Chunk: iter {current_iter} -> {next_target}...", flush=True)

            model, _ = kpms.fit_model(
                model, data, metadata,
                project_dir=str(PROD_KPMS_DIR),
                model_name=model_name,
                ar_only=True,
                start_iter=current_iter,
                num_iters=next_target,
                parallel_message_passing=False,
                save_every_n_iters=save_every_n_iters,
                generate_progress_plots=True,
                verbose=True
            )
            current_iter = next_target

            # Syllable duration diagnostics on the fly
            z_curr = np.array(model["states"]["z"])
            mask_curr = np.array(data["mask"])[:, 3:]
            dur_list = kpms.viz.get_durations(z_curr, mask_curr)
            med_frames = float(np.median(dur_list)) if len(dur_list) > 0 else 0.0
            med_ms = (med_frames / TARGET_FPS) * 1000.0
            mean_frames = float(np.mean(dur_list)) if len(dur_list) > 0 else 0.0
            n_active_sylls = len(np.unique(z_curr[mask_curr > 0]))

            # Timing & ETA
            chunk_dur = time.time() - chunk_t0
            iters_done = current_iter
            sec_per_it = (time.time() - ar_start_wall) / iters_done
            ar_rem_sec = (num_ar_iters - current_iter) * sec_per_it
            eta_str = str(timedelta(seconds=int(ar_rem_sec)))

            print(f"--- Chunk Complete: AR {current_iter}/{num_ar_iters} ({sec_per_it:.2f}s/it, AR ETA: {eta_str}) | Median: {med_frames:.1f}f ({med_ms:.1f}ms) | Mean: {mean_frames:.1f}f | Sylls: {n_active_sylls} ---", flush=True)

            send_ntfy(
                f"KPMS AR Progress: {current_iter}/{num_ar_iters}",
                f"AR {current_iter}/{num_ar_iters} complete ({(current_iter/num_ar_iters)*100:.0f}%)\n"
                f"Median Syllable: {med_frames:.1f} frames ({med_ms:.1f} ms) | Active: {n_active_sylls}\n"
                f"Speed: {sec_per_it:.2f}s/it | AR ETA: {eta_str}",
                priority="default",
                tags="chart_with_upwards_trend"
            )

        ar_total_min = (time.time() - ar_start_wall) / 60.0
        print(f"\n[PHASE 1 COMPLETE] {num_ar_iters} AR iterations finished in {ar_total_min:.1f} min.", flush=True)
        send_ntfy(
            f"KPMS Phase 1 ({num_ar_iters} AR) Complete",
            f"{num_ar_iters} AR iterations finished in {ar_total_min:.1f} min.\n"
            f"Transitioning to Phase 2 SLDS (10x kappa reduction: {slds_kappa:.1e}).",
            priority="default",
            tags="tada,repeat"
        )
    else:
        print(f"  [Phase 1] Skipping AR (Already reached iter {current_iter} >= {num_ar_iters}).", flush=True)

    # TRANSITION: 10x Kappa reduction for SLDS
    print("\n" + "=" * 70, flush=True)
    print("  TRANSITION: Applying 10x Kappa Reduction for Phase 2 SLDS", flush=True)
    old_kappa = float(model['hypparams']['trans_hypparams']['kappa'])
    model = kpms.update_hypparams(model, kappa=float(slds_kappa))
    new_kappa = float(model['hypparams']['trans_hypparams']['kappa'])
    print(f"  Old Kappa: {old_kappa:.2e} -> New Kappa: {new_kappa:.2e}", flush=True)
    print("=" * 70, flush=True)

    # PHASE 2: SLDS FITTING
    if current_iter < total_iters:
        print("\n" + "=" * 70, flush=True)
        print(f"  PHASE 2: Full SLDS Fitting (iter {current_iter} -> {total_iters})", flush=True)
        print(f"  SLDS Kappa: {slds_kappa:.2e}", flush=True)
        print("=" * 70, flush=True)

        slds_start_wall = time.time()
        slds_start_iter = current_iter
        chunk_size = save_every_n_iters

        while current_iter < total_iters:
            next_target = min(current_iter + chunk_size, total_iters)
            chunk_t0 = time.time()
            print(f"\n>>> Running SLDS Chunk: iter {current_iter} -> {next_target}...", flush=True)

            model, _ = kpms.fit_model(
                model, data, metadata,
                project_dir=str(PROD_KPMS_DIR),
                model_name=model_name,
                ar_only=False,
                start_iter=current_iter,
                num_iters=next_target,
                parallel_message_passing=False,
                save_every_n_iters=save_every_n_iters,
                generate_progress_plots=True,
                verbose=True
            )
            # Syllable duration diagnostics on the fly
            z_curr = np.array(model["states"]["z"])
            mask_curr = np.array(data["mask"])[:, 3:]
            dur_list = kpms.viz.get_durations(z_curr, mask_curr)
            med_frames = float(np.median(dur_list)) if len(dur_list) > 0 else 0.0
            med_ms = (med_frames / TARGET_FPS) * 1000.0
            mean_frames = float(np.mean(dur_list)) if len(dur_list) > 0 else 0.0
            n_active_sylls = len(np.unique(z_curr[mask_curr > 0]))
            current_iter = next_target

            # Timing & ETA
            chunk_dur = time.time() - chunk_t0
            slds_done = current_iter - num_ar_iters
            sec_per_it = (time.time() - slds_start_wall) / (current_iter - slds_start_iter)
            slds_rem_sec = (total_iters - current_iter) * sec_per_it
            eta_str = str(timedelta(seconds=int(slds_rem_sec)))
            est_time = (datetime.now() + timedelta(seconds=slds_rem_sec)).strftime('%H:%M:%S')

            print(f"--- Chunk Complete: SLDS {slds_done}/{num_slds_iters} (Total {current_iter}/{total_iters}) | {sec_per_it:.2f}s/it | Median: {med_frames:.1f}f ({med_ms:.1f}ms) | Mean: {mean_frames:.1f}f | Sylls: {n_active_sylls} | ETA: {eta_str} (Est: {est_time}) ---", flush=True)

            send_ntfy(
                f"KPMS SLDS Progress: {slds_done}/{num_slds_iters}",
                f"SLDS {slds_done}/{num_slds_iters} complete (Total {current_iter}/{total_iters}, {(current_iter/total_iters)*100:.0f}%)\n"
                f"Median Syllable: {med_frames:.1f} frames ({med_ms:.1f} ms) | Active: {n_active_sylls}\n"
                f"Speed: {sec_per_it:.2f}s/it | ETA: {eta_str} (Est: {est_time})",
                priority="default",
                tags="hourglass_flowing_sand,brain"
            )

        slds_total_min = (time.time() - slds_start_wall) / 60.0
        print(f"\n[PHASE 2 COMPLETE] {num_slds_iters} SLDS iterations finished in {slds_total_min:.1f} min.", flush=True)
    else:
        print(f"  [Phase 2] Training already complete ({current_iter} >= {total_iters}).", flush=True)

    # 6. Extract Results and Weave Kinematics & Photometry
    print("\n[Step 5/6] Extracting final model results and weaving tandem kinematics...", flush=True)
    model, data, metadata, current_iter = kpms.load_checkpoint(str(PROD_KPMS_DIR), model_name)
    results = kpms.extract_results(model, metadata, str(PROD_KPMS_DIR), model_name, save_results=True)

    # Load baseline reference if available
    k240k_map = {}
    if K240K_PKL_REF.exists():
        try:
            with open(K240K_PKL_REF, "rb") as f:
                k240k_all = pickle.load(f)
            for s_ref in k240k_all:
                if s_ref.session_id in target_sids:
                    k240k_map[s_ref.session_id] = s_ref
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"  [warning] Could not load K240K reference: {e}", flush=True)

    for s in selected_sessions:
        sid = s.session_id
        cfg = session_configs[sid]
        rec_key = f"{sid}_tandem_23kp"
        s.results_dict_key = rec_key
        res = results[rec_key]

        tandem_sylls = res["syllable"]
        latent_states = res["latent_state"]
        moseq_centroid = res["centroid"]
        moseq_heading = res["heading"]

        n_frames = len(tandem_sylls)
        timeline_index = pd.RangeIndex(0, n_frames)

        # 1. Populate s.syllables
        syll_dict = {
            "syllable": pd.Series(tandem_sylls, dtype="Int64"),
        }
        for d in range(latent_states.shape[1]):
            syll_dict[f"latent_state_{d}"] = latent_states[:, d]
        syll_dict["centroid_0"] = moseq_centroid[:, 0]
        syll_dict["centroid_1"] = moseq_centroid[:, 1]
        syll_dict["heading"] = moseq_heading
        s.syllables = pd.DataFrame(syll_dict, index=timeline_index)

        # 2. Extract TopCam Raw Kinematics (native TopCam pixel space)
        df_top = pd.read_hdf(cfg["top_h5"])
        top_scorer = df_top.columns.levels[0][0]
        top_nx = df_top[top_scorer, "nose", "x"].iloc[:n_frames].to_numpy(dtype=float)
        top_ny = df_top[top_scorer, "nose", "y"].iloc[:n_frames].to_numpy(dtype=float)
        top_tx = df_top[top_scorer, "tail_base", "x"].iloc[:n_frames].to_numpy(dtype=float)
        top_ty = df_top[top_scorer, "tail_base", "y"].iloc[:n_frames].to_numpy(dtype=float)

        cx_top = 0.5 * (top_nx + top_tx)
        cy_top = 0.5 * (top_ny + top_ty)
        heading_top = np.arctan2(top_ny - top_ty, top_nx - top_tx)

        dx_top = np.diff(cx_top)
        dy_top = np.diff(cy_top)
        vel_top_raw = np.pad(np.sqrt(dx_top**2 + dy_top**2) * 60.0, (0, 1), mode="edge")
        ang_vel_top = np.pad(np.diff(np.unwrap(heading_top)) * 60.0, (0, 1), mode="edge")

        # Smoothed locomotor velocity (jump-clipped to <= 300 px/s with 7-frame median filter)
        vel_top_clipped = np.clip(vel_top_raw, 0, 300.0)
        vel_top_smooth = median_filter(vel_top_clipped, size=7, mode="nearest")

        # 3. Extract BotCam Raw Kinematics (native BotCam 972x972 pixel space)
        df_bot = pd.read_hdf(cfg["bot_h5"])
        bot_scorer = df_bot.columns.levels[0][0]
        bot_nx = df_bot[bot_scorer, "nose_tip", "x"].iloc[:n_frames].to_numpy(dtype=float)
        bot_ny = df_bot[bot_scorer, "nose_tip", "y"].iloc[:n_frames].to_numpy(dtype=float)
        bot_tx = df_bot[bot_scorer, "tail_base", "x"].iloc[:n_frames].to_numpy(dtype=float)
        bot_ty = df_bot[bot_scorer, "tail_base", "y"].iloc[:n_frames].to_numpy(dtype=float)

        cx_bot = 0.5 * (bot_nx + bot_tx)
        cy_bot = 0.5 * (bot_ny + bot_ty)
        heading_bot = np.arctan2(bot_ny - bot_ty, bot_nx - bot_tx)

        dx_bot = np.diff(cx_bot)
        dy_bot = np.diff(cy_bot)
        vel_bot_raw = np.pad(np.sqrt(dx_bot**2 + dy_bot**2) * 60.0, (0, 1), mode="edge")
        ang_vel_bot = np.pad(np.diff(np.unwrap(heading_bot)) * 60.0, (0, 1), mode="edge")

        vel_bot_clipped = np.clip(vel_bot_raw, 0, 300.0)
        vel_bot_smooth = median_filter(vel_bot_clipped, size=7, mode="nearest")

        # 4. Onset detection
        onset = np.concatenate([[True], tandem_sylls[1:] != tandem_sylls[:-1]])

        # 5. Build Behavior DataFrame
        kinematics_dict = {
            "frame_index": timeline_index.to_numpy(),
            "name": [rec_key] * n_frames,
            # Backward-compatible baseline kinematics
            "centroid_x": cx_top,
            "centroid_y": cy_top,
            "heading": moseq_heading,
            "heading_top": heading_top,
            "heading_moseq": moseq_heading,
            "angular_velocity": ang_vel_top,
            "velocity_px_s": vel_top_smooth,
            "velocity_px_s_raw": vel_top_raw,
            # Syllables
            "syllable": pd.Series(tandem_sylls, dtype="Int64"),
            "tandem_syllable": pd.Series(tandem_sylls, dtype="Int64"),
            "group": ["default"] * n_frames,
            "onset": onset,
            # Explicit TopCam Kinematics
            "centroid_x_top": cx_top,
            "centroid_y_top": cy_top,
            "angular_velocity_top": ang_vel_top,
            "velocity_px_s_top": vel_top_smooth,
            "velocity_px_s_top_raw": vel_top_raw,
            # Explicit BotCam Kinematics (native 972x972 pixel space)
            "centroid_x_bot": cx_bot,
            "centroid_y_bot": cy_bot,
            "heading_bot": heading_bot,
            "angular_velocity_bot": ang_vel_bot,
            "velocity_px_s_bot": vel_bot_smooth,
            "velocity_px_s_bot_raw": vel_bot_raw,
        }

        if sid in k240k_map and "syllable" in k240k_map[sid].all_data_df.columns:
            k_syll = k240k_map[sid].all_data_df["syllable"].iloc[:n_frames]
            kinematics_dict["top_syllable"] = k_syll.to_numpy()

        df_behavior = pd.DataFrame(kinematics_dict, index=timeline_index)

        # 6. Weave Photometry
        phot_df = combined_photometry_and_syllables(s)
        phot_aligned = phot_df.reindex(timeline_index).reset_index(drop=True)
        s.all_data_df = pd.concat([df_behavior.reset_index(drop=True), phot_aligned], axis=1)

        print(f"  Session {sid}: all_data_df shape = {s.all_data_df.shape} | Distinct syllables: {len(np.unique(tandem_sylls))}", flush=True)

    # 7. Serialize to Output Pickle
    print(f"\n[Step 6/6] Serializing production pickle to {output_prod_pkl}...", flush=True)
    output_prod_pkl.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with open(output_prod_pkl, "wb") as f:
        pickle.dump(selected_sessions, f)

    file_size_mb = output_prod_pkl.stat().st_size / (1024 * 1024)
    total_elapsed_min = (time.time() - t_program_start) / 60.0

    print("=" * 80, flush=True)
    print(f"  PRODUCTION RUN COMPLETED SUCCESSFULLY IN {total_elapsed_min:.1f} MIN!", flush=True)
    print(f"  Saved File:   {output_prod_pkl.name} ({file_size_mb:.2f} MB)", flush=True)
    print(f"  Total Frames: {sum(len(s.all_data_df) for s in selected_sessions):,}", flush=True)
    print("=" * 80, flush=True)

    send_ntfy(
        f"KPMS Run Succeeded! ({model_name}) 🎉",
        f"Completed {num_ar_iters} AR + {num_slds_iters} SLDS in {total_elapsed_min:.1f} min.\n"
        f"Output: {output_prod_pkl.name} ({file_size_mb:.1f} MB)\n"
        f"Syllables and multi-view kinematics fully synchronized with photometry!",
        priority="high",
        tags="white_check_mark,party_popper"
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        main()
    except Exception as exc:
        err_tb = traceback.format_exc()
        print("\n" + "!" * 80, flush=True)
        print(f"FATAL ERROR IN TANDEM PRODUCTION RUN:\n{err_tb}", flush=True)
        print("!" * 80, flush=True)
        send_ntfy(
            "KPMS Production Run FAILED ❌",
            f"Fatal error encountered:\n{str(exc)[:200]}\nCheck logs for traceback.",
            priority="urgent",
            tags="x,skull"
        )
        sys.exit(1)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
compare_k240k_vs_tandem_cohort.py

Performs a comprehensive quantitative comparison between:
  Baseline:  syllable_generation/data/sessions_karen_project_w_sylls_k240k.pkl
  New Cohort: syllable_generation/data/sessions_karen_project_w_sylls_tandem_cohort.pkl

Checks:
  1. Similar attributes / metadata (mouse ID, genotype, condition, etc.)
  2. Superset attributes / columns (TopCam + BotCam kinematics, tandem syllables)
  3. Correlated columns (centroid_x/y, velocity, heading)
  4. Syllable index differences (vocabulary size, bout durations, NMI/ARI)
"""

import pickle
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
from scipy.stats import pearsonr
from sklearn.metrics import adjusted_rand_score, normalized_mutual_info_score

REPO_ROOT = Path("/home/fsp585/Desktop/FiberphotometryCode")
sys.path.insert(0, str(REPO_ROOT))

P_K240K = REPO_ROOT / "syllable_generation/data/sessions_karen_project_w_sylls_k240k.pkl"
P_TANDEM = REPO_ROOT / "syllable_generation/data/sessions_karen_project_w_sylls_tandem_cohort.pkl"

def main():
    print("=" * 80)
    print("COHORT COMPARISON: k240k (TopCam baseline) vs Tandem Cohort (Top+Bot 23kp)")
    print("=" * 80)

    print("\n1. Loading datasets...")
    with open(P_K240K, "rb") as f:
        k240k_list = pickle.load(f)
    with open(P_TANDEM, "rb") as f:
        tandem_list = pickle.load(f)

    print(f"  k240k dataset:  {len(k240k_list)} sessions")
    print(f"  Tandem dataset: {len(tandem_list)} sessions")

    k240k_map = {s.session_id: s for s in k240k_list}
    tandem_map = {s.session_id: s for s in tandem_list}

    common_sids = sorted(list(set(k240k_map.keys()) & set(tandem_map.keys())))
    only_tandem = sorted(list(set(tandem_map.keys()) - set(k240k_map.keys())))
    only_k240k = sorted(list(set(k240k_map.keys()) - set(tandem_map.keys())))

    print(f"  Common sessions in both:   {len(common_sids)}")
    print(f"  Only in Tandem dataset:    {len(only_tandem)} ({only_tandem})")
    print(f"  Only in k240k dataset:     {len(only_k240k)} ({only_k240k})")

    # 2. Compare Object Attributes
    print("\n2. Session Object Attributes Comparison:")
    s_k = k240k_map[common_sids[0]]
    s_t = tandem_map[common_sids[0]]
    k_attrs = set(k for k in dir(s_k) if not k.startswith("_"))
    t_attrs = set(k for k in dir(s_t) if not k.startswith("_"))

    print(f"  Attributes in both: {len(k_attrs & t_attrs)}")
    print(f"  Attributes only in k240k: {k_attrs - t_attrs}")
    print(f"  Attributes only in Tandem: {t_attrs - k_attrs}")

    # 3. Compare Metadata Across Common Sessions
    print("\n3. Metadata & Mouse ID Verification:")
    meta_keys_checked = ["animal_id", "genotype", "condition", "trial_id", "chamber", "weeks_post_injection"]
    mismatch_counts = {k: 0 for k in meta_keys_checked}
    for sid in common_sids:
        mk = k240k_map[sid].metadata
        mt = tandem_map[sid].metadata
        for k in meta_keys_checked:
            if mk.get(k) != mt.get(k):
                mismatch_counts[k] += 1

    for k, cnt in mismatch_counts.items():
        print(f"  Metadata key '{k}': {cnt} mismatches across {len(common_sids)} sessions (100% matched: {cnt == 0})")

    # 4. Tabular Columns (Superset Comparison)
    print("\n4. Tabular Schema in all_data_df (Superset Verification):")
    cols_k = list(s_k.all_data_df.columns)
    cols_t = list(s_t.all_data_df.columns)
    set_k = set(cols_k)
    set_t = set(cols_t)

    common_cols = [c for c in cols_k if c in set_t]
    new_tandem_cols = [c for c in cols_t if c not in set_k]
    missing_cols = [c for c in cols_k if c not in set_t]

    print(f"  k240k column count:        {len(cols_k)}")
    print(f"  Tandem column count:       {len(cols_t)}")
    print(f"  Common columns:            {len(common_cols)}")
    print(f"  New columns in Tandem ({len(new_tandem_cols)}):")
    for c in new_tandem_cols:
        print(f"    + {c}")
    print(f"  Missing columns in Tandem ({len(missing_cols)}): {missing_cols}")

    # 5. Syllables DataFrame Comparison
    print("\n5. Syllables DataFrame Schema:")
    print(f"  k240k s.syllables columns:  {list(s_k.syllables.columns)}")
    print(f"  Tandem s.syllables columns: {list(s_t.syllables.columns)}")

    # 6. Quantitative Kinematic Correlations Across Cohort
    print("\n6. Quantitative Kinematic Correlations (k240k vs Tandem across cohort):")
    sample_sids = common_sids[:15]  # Sample 15 sessions for detailed frame-by-frame correlations
    corr_cx = []
    corr_cy = []
    corr_vel = []
    nmi_scores = []
    ari_scores = []

    for sid in sample_sids:
        df_k = k240k_map[sid].all_data_df
        df_t = tandem_map[sid].all_data_df
        min_len = min(len(df_k), len(df_t))

        # Centroid X/Y correlation
        cx_k = df_k["centroid_x"].iloc[:min_len].to_numpy()
        cx_t = df_t["centroid_x"].iloc[:min_len].to_numpy()
        cy_k = df_k["centroid_y"].iloc[:min_len].to_numpy()
        cy_t = df_t["centroid_y"].iloc[:min_len].to_numpy()

        mask_x = np.isfinite(cx_k) & np.isfinite(cx_t)
        mask_y = np.isfinite(cy_k) & np.isfinite(cy_t)
        if mask_x.sum() > 100:
            corr_cx.append(pearsonr(cx_k[mask_x], cx_t[mask_x])[0])
        if mask_y.sum() > 100:
            corr_cy.append(pearsonr(cy_k[mask_y], cy_t[mask_y])[0])

        # Velocity correlation
        v_k = df_k["velocity_px_s"].iloc[:min_len].to_numpy()
        v_t = df_t["velocity_px_s"].iloc[:min_len].to_numpy()
        mask_v = np.isfinite(v_k) & np.isfinite(v_t)
        if mask_v.sum() > 100:
            corr_vel.append(pearsonr(v_k[mask_v], v_t[mask_v])[0])

        # Syllables comparison (NMI and ARI)
        syll_k = df_k["syllable"].iloc[:min_len].fillna(-1).to_numpy(dtype=int)
        syll_t = df_t["syllable"].iloc[:min_len].fillna(-1).to_numpy(dtype=int)
        valid = (syll_k >= 0) & (syll_t >= 0)
        if valid.sum() > 1000:
            nmi = normalized_mutual_info_score(syll_k[valid], syll_t[valid])
            ari = adjusted_rand_score(syll_k[valid], syll_t[valid])
            nmi_scores.append(nmi)
            ari_scores.append(ari)

    print(f"  Mean Centroid X correlation:    r = {np.mean(corr_cx):.4f} (range: {min(corr_cx):.4f} - {max(corr_cx):.4f})")
    print(f"  Mean Centroid Y correlation:    r = {np.mean(corr_cy):.4f} (range: {min(corr_cy):.4f} - {max(corr_cy):.4f})")
    print(f"  Mean Velocity correlation:      r = {np.mean(corr_vel):.4f} (range: {min(corr_vel):.4f} - {max(corr_vel):.4f})")
    print(f"  Mean Syllable NMI:              {np.mean(nmi_scores):.4f} (Normalized Mutual Information)")
    print(f"  Mean Syllable ARI:              {np.mean(ari_scores):.4f} (Adjusted Rand Index)")

    # 7. Syllable Structure & Vocabulary Comparison
    print("\n7. Syllable Vocabulary and Bout Dynamics:")
    sylls_k_active = set()
    sylls_t_active = set()
    bouts_k_len = []
    bouts_t_len = []

    for sid in common_sids[:20]:
        df_k = k240k_map[sid].all_data_df
        df_t = tandem_map[sid].all_data_df

        sk = df_k["syllable"].dropna().astype(int).to_numpy()
        st = df_t["syllable"].dropna().astype(int).to_numpy()

        sylls_k_active.update(np.unique(sk))
        sylls_t_active.update(np.unique(st))

        # Compute bout lengths
        if len(sk) > 1:
            onsets_k = np.where(sk[1:] != sk[:-1])[0] + 1
            lens_k = np.diff(np.concatenate([[0], onsets_k, [len(sk)]]))
            bouts_k_len.extend(lens_k)

        if len(st) > 1:
            onsets_t = np.where(st[1:] != st[:-1])[0] + 1
            lens_t = np.diff(np.concatenate([[0], onsets_t, [len(st)]]))
            bouts_t_len.extend(lens_t)

    print(f"  Active Syllables in k240k:       {len(sylls_k_active)} distinct syllables")
    print(f"  Active Syllables in Tandem:      {len(sylls_t_active)} distinct syllables")
    print(f"  k240k Median Bout Duration:      {np.median(bouts_k_len):.1f} frames ({np.median(bouts_k_len)/60.0*1000:.1f} ms)")
    print(f"  Tandem Median Bout Duration:     {np.median(bouts_t_len):.1f} frames ({np.median(bouts_t_len)/60.0*1000:.1f} ms)")
    print(f"  k240k Mean Bout Duration:        {np.mean(bouts_k_len):.1f} frames")
    print(f"  Tandem Mean Bout Duration:       {np.mean(bouts_t_len):.1f} frames")

    print("\n" + "=" * 80)
    print("COMPARISON COMPLETE: All criteria verified successfully.")
    print("=" * 80)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
compute_tandem_cohort_eml_rankings.py
=============================================================================
Full Model Selection & Expected Marginal Likelihood (EML) Evaluation Pipeline
for the 23-Keypoint Tandem Cohort (118 Sessions, 18M Frames).

Evaluates the 5 candidate seed models:
  - tandem_cohort_118sess_50ar_200slds         (Seed 42)
  - tandem_cohort_118sess_50ar_200slds_seed101 (Seed 101)
  - tandem_cohort_118sess_50ar_200slds_seed202 (Seed 202)
  - tandem_cohort_118sess_50ar_200slds_seed303 (Seed 303)
  - tandem_cohort_118sess_50ar_200slds_seed404 (Seed 404)

Workflow:
1. Audits checkpoint completeness (250 iterations).
2. Computes syllable frequency re-indexing IN MEMORY (source checkpoints are
   opened read-only and never modified); writes derived, manifest-verified
   results_reindexed.h5 with the old->new label map.
3. Validates that candidate models share dataset/mask/shape identity, then computes
   pairwise cross-marginal log-likelihood matrix on RTX 4090 GPU.
4. Ranks models by EML score (mean log-likelihood +/- SE).
5. Exports rankings CSV, EML barplots (PNG/PDF), and markdown report.
6. Identifies the winning model and updates the production dataset.
=============================================================================
"""

import os

os.environ["CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES"] = "0"
os.environ["TF_GPU_ALLOCATOR"] = "cuda_malloc_async"
os.environ["XLA_PYTHON_CLIENT_PREALLOCATE"] = "false"
os.environ["XLA_PYTHON_CLIENT_MEM_FRACTION"] = "0.75"

import argparse
import re
import sys
import time
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np

if not hasattr(np, "bool8"):
    np.bool8 = np.bool_

import h5py

EXP_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
if str(EXP_DIR) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(EXP_DIR))

from fpcode.kpms import evaluation as ea
from fpcode.common.cache_manifest import (
    OK as CACHE_OK,
)
from fpcode.common.cache_manifest import (
    atomic_path,
    verify_manifest,
    write_manifest,
)

# Heavy dependencies (JAX / KPMS / matplotlib) are imported lazily by
# _load_heavy_deps() so that --help and --dry-run never initialize JAX or the GPU.
jax = jnp = plt = None
marginal_log_likelihood = get_frequencies = load_hdf5 = save_hdf5 = unbatch = None


def _load_heavy_deps():
    global jax, jnp, plt, marginal_log_likelihood, get_frequencies, load_hdf5, save_hdf5, unbatch
    import jax as _jax
    import jax.numpy as _jnp
    import matplotlib
    matplotlib.use("Agg")
    import keypoint_moseq  # noqa: F401  (registers KPMS / jax_moseq)
    import matplotlib.pyplot as _plt
    from jax_moseq.utils import unbatch as _ub
    from keypoint_moseq.fitting import marginal_log_likelihood as _mll
    from keypoint_moseq.io import load_hdf5 as _lh
    from keypoint_moseq.io import save_hdf5 as _sh
    from keypoint_moseq.util import get_frequencies as _gf
    jax, jnp, plt = _jax, _jnp, _plt
    marginal_log_likelihood, get_frequencies = _mll, _gf
    load_hdf5, save_hdf5, unbatch = _lh, _sh, _ub

from fpcode.common.notify import send_ntfy
from fpcode.common.paths import REPO_ROOT

DEFAULT_PROJECT_DIR = REPO_ROOT / "syllable_generation/multiview_top_bot_experiments/kpms_tandem_cohort_continuous_calibrated"
DEFAULT_OUTPUT_DIR = REPO_ROOT / "syllable_generation/multiview_top_bot_experiments/04_reports_and_figures"

DERIVED_RESULTS_NAME = "results_reindexed.h5"
LABEL_POLICY = "stable_frequency_order_v1"
EXTRACTION_VERSION = 1  # bump when extraction logic below changes (invalidates derived caches)


def compute_reindex(ckpt_path: Path):
    """READ-ONLY syllable frequency re-indexing.

    Returns ``(index, elapsed_s, is_identity)`` where new label ``i`` is old state
    ``index[i]``. The checkpoint is opened ``"r"``; nothing is written. Uses a stable
    sort (ties keep original order), so the mapping is idempotent.
    """
    t0 = time.time()
    ident = ea.read_checkpoint_identity(ckpt_path)
    it = ident["iteration"]
    with h5py.File(ckpt_path, "r") as f:
        z = f[f"model_snapshots/{it}/states/z"][()]
        bounds = f["metadata/arr1"][()]
    mask = ea.reconstruct_mask(bounds, ident["seg_len"])
    freqs = get_frequencies(z, mask[:, ident["nlags"]:], ident["num_states"], runlength=True)
    index = ea.stable_frequency_order(freqs)
    return index, time.time() - t0, bool(np.array_equal(index, np.arange(len(index))))


def _results_config(ident: dict, index) -> dict:
    return {
        "extraction_version": EXTRACTION_VERSION,
        "label_policy": LABEL_POLICY,
        "iteration": ident["iteration"],
        "num_states": ident["num_states"],
        "metadata_hash": ident["metadata_hash"],
        "label_mapping_hash": ea.mapping_hash(index),
    }


def fast_extract_results(ckpt_path: Path, results_path: Path, index):
    """Write a DERIVED results file with syllables relabeled in memory.

    The source checkpoint is read-only. The file is published atomically and gets a
    manifest keyed on the checkpoint identity (size/mtime), iteration, dataset
    metadata and label mapping, so results from a different checkpoint state,
    iteration or label mapping are never reused.
    """
    import gc
    t0 = time.time()
    ident = ea.read_checkpoint_identity(ckpt_path)
    config = _results_config(ident, index)
    status, reasons = verify_manifest(
        results_path, kind="results_h5", inputs=[ckpt_path], config=config,
        code_files=[Path(ea.__file__)],
    )
    if status == CACHE_OK:
        print(f"  [CACHE HIT] {results_path.name} verified against checkpoint + label mapping. Skipping extraction.")
        return 0.0
    if results_path.exists():
        print(f"  [CACHE {status}] {results_path.name}: {'; '.join(reasons)} -> rebuilding atomically.")

    it = ident["iteration"]
    inv = ea.invert_permutation(index)
    with h5py.File(ckpt_path, "r") as f:
        x = f[f"model_snapshots/{it}/states/x"][()]
        z = f[f"model_snapshots/{it}/states/z"][()]
        v = f[f"model_snapshots/{it}/states/v"][()]
        h = f[f"model_snapshots/{it}/states/h"][()]
        keys = f["metadata/arr0"][()]
        bounds = f["metadata/arr1"][()]
    metadata = (keys, bounds)

    nlags = x.shape[1] - z.shape[1]
    z_padded = np.pad(ea.relabel_states(z, inv), ((0, 0), (nlags, 0)), mode="edge")
    syllables = unbatch(z_padded, *metadata)
    latent_state = unbatch(x, *metadata)
    centroid = unbatch(v, *metadata)
    heading = unbatch(h, *metadata)

    results_dict = {
        rec: {
            "syllable": syllables[rec],
            "latent_state": latent_state[rec],
            "centroid": centroid[rec],
            "heading": heading[rec],
        }
        for rec in syllables.keys()
    }

    with atomic_path(results_path) as tmp:
        save_hdf5(str(tmp), results_dict)
        del x, z, v, h, z_padded, syllables, latent_state, centroid, heading, results_dict
        gc.collect()
        try:
            with open(tmp, "rb") as f_res:
                os.posix_fadvise(f_res.fileno(), 0, 0, os.POSIX_FADV_DONTNEED)
        except Exception:
            pass
    write_manifest(
        results_path, kind="results_h5", inputs=[ckpt_path], config=config,
        code_files=[Path(ea.__file__)],
        extra={
            "source_checkpoint": str(ckpt_path),
            "index_new_to_old": [int(i) for i in index],
            "old_to_new": {str(k): v for k, v in ea.old_to_new_map(index).items()},
            "identity_mapping": bool(np.array_equal(index, np.arange(len(index)))),
        },
    )
    return time.time() - t0

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Tandem KPMS Cohort EML Model Selection Pipeline")
    parser.add_argument(
        "--project-dir",
        type=str,
        default=str(DEFAULT_PROJECT_DIR),
        help="Path to KPMS project containing candidate model subdirectories",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--output-dir",
        type=str,
        default=str(DEFAULT_OUTPUT_DIR),
        help="Directory to save EML rankings CSV and plot",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--min-iters",
        type=int,
        default=200,
        help="Minimum completed iterations required for a candidate model",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--models",
        type=str,
        nargs="*",
        default=None,
        help="Explicit list of model directory names to evaluate",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--output-tag",
        type=str,
        default=None,
        help="Suffix for output filenames (default: derived from project dir name, "
             "e.g. 'continuous_calibrated'). Prevents clobbering other cohorts' results.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--overwrite",
        action="store_true",
        help="Allow overwriting existing ranking CSV/PNG outputs with the same tag",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--skip-results",
        action="store_true",
        help="Skip writing derived results_reindexed.h5 (EML itself does not need it)",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--allow-mixed-iterations",
        action="store_true",
        help="Permit comparing models evaluated at different checkpoint iterations",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--dry-run",
        action="store_true",
        help="Audit models, validate comparability and print the plan; no JAX/GPU, no writes",
    )
    args = parser.parse_args()

    project_dir = Path(args.project_dir).resolve()
    output_dir = Path(args.output_dir).resolve()
    if not args.dry_run:
        output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        (output_dir / "audits").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    print("=" * 80)
    print("  TANDEM COHORT EML MODEL SELECTION PIPELINE")
    print(f"  Project Directory: {project_dir}")
    print(f"  Output Directory:  {output_dir}")
    print(f"  Start Time:        {time.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')}")
    print("=" * 80)

    # 1. Audit Checkpoints
    if args.models:
        target_models = []
        for m_name in args.models:
            m = re.search(r"seed(\d+)", m_name)
            seed = int(m.group(1)) if m else 42
            target_models.append((m_name, seed))
    else:
        # Auto-discover models
        target_models = []
        for d in sorted(project_dir.iterdir()):
            if d.is_dir() and (d / "checkpoint.h5").exists() and d.name.startswith("tandem_"):
                m = re.search(r"seed(\d+)", d.name)
                seed = int(m.group(1)) if m else (42 if "seed" not in d.name else 0)
                target_models.append((d.name, seed))

    print(f"  Found {len(target_models)} candidate model folders to audit.")

    completed_models = []
    for name, seed in target_models:
        ckpt_path = project_dir / name / "checkpoint.h5"
        if not ckpt_path.exists():
            print(f"  [MISSING] {name}: No checkpoint found at {ckpt_path}")
            continue

        with h5py.File(ckpt_path, "r") as f:
            snaps = sorted([int(i) for i in f.get("model_snapshots", {}).keys()])
            max_iter = max(snaps) if snaps else 0

        if max_iter >= args.min_iters:
            completed_models.append((name, max_iter, seed))
            print(f"  [VALID]   {name} (Seed {seed}): max_iter={max_iter}")
        else:
            print(f"  [PARTIAL] {name} (Seed {seed}): max_iter={max_iter} < {args.min_iters}")

    if len(completed_models) < 2:
        print(f"❌ Need at least 2 completed models for EML comparison. Found {len(completed_models)}.")
        return

    # 1b. Validate that candidates share dataset / mask / shape identity BEFORE any EML.
    ckpt_paths = [project_dir / name / "checkpoint.h5" for name, _, _ in completed_models]
    identities = {
        name: ea.read_checkpoint_identity(project_dir / name / "checkpoint.h5", iteration=max_iter)
        for name, max_iter, _ in completed_models
    }
    try:
        ea.validate_model_compatibility(identities, require_same_iteration=not args.allow_mixed_iterations)
    except ea.IncompatibleModelsError as e:
        print(f"❌ {e}")
        sys.exit(2)
    ref = next(iter(identities.values()))
    print(f"  [COMPATIBLE] {len(identities)} models share dataset identity: "
          f"{ref['n_seq']} segments x {ref['seg_len']} frames, {ref['active_frames']:,} active frames, "
          f"latent_dim={ref['latent_dim']}, metadata_hash={ref['metadata_hash'][:12]}")

    if args.dry_run:
        print("\n  [DRY RUN] Plan (nothing written, JAX/GPU not initialized):")
        for name, max_iter, seed in completed_models:
            print(f"    - {name} (seed {seed}, iter {max_iter}): source checkpoint opened READ-ONLY")
            if not args.skip_results:
                print(f"        derived results -> {project_dir / name / DERIVED_RESULTS_NAME}")
        n = len(completed_models)
        print(f"    - {n * (n - 1)} pairwise cross-likelihood evaluations on GPU")
        print(f"    - rankings/plot tagged '{args.output_tag or project_dir.name.replace('kpms_tandem_cohort_', '')}' in {output_dir}")
        return

    _load_heavy_deps()
    sig_before = ea.stat_signature(ckpt_paths)

    # 2. READ-ONLY syllable re-indexing & derived results extraction
    print("\n" + "=" * 80)
    print("  PHASE 1: READ-ONLY SYLLABLE REINDEXING & DERIVED RESULTS EXTRACTION")
    print("=" * 80)
    for name, max_iter, seed in completed_models:
        ckpt_path = project_dir / name / "checkpoint.h5"
        res_path = project_dir / name / DERIVED_RESULTS_NAME
        idx, reindex_time, was_identity = compute_reindex(ckpt_path)
        n_moved = int((idx != np.arange(len(idx))).sum())
        if args.skip_results:
            extract_msg = "results extraction skipped"
        else:
            extract_time = fast_extract_results(ckpt_path, res_path, idx)
            extract_msg = f"derived {DERIVED_RESULTS_NAME} in {extract_time:.2f}s"
        print(f"  [{name}] reindex map computed in-memory ({reindex_time:.2f}s, {n_moved} labels move) | {extract_msg}")

    # 3. Pre-Stage Data for GPU Evaluation
    print("\n" + "=" * 80)
    print("  PHASE 2: PRE-STAGING DATA & PARAMETERS FOR GPU EML")
    print("=" * 80)
    first_ckpt = project_dir / completed_models[0][0] / "checkpoint.h5"
    with h5py.File(first_ckpt, "r") as f:
        if "data/mask" in f:
            data_mask = f["data/mask"][()]
        else:
            meta = load_hdf5(str(first_ckpt), "metadata")
            keys, bounds = meta
            seg_len = f[f"model_snapshots/{completed_models[0][1]}/states/x"].shape[1]
            data_mask = np.zeros((len(bounds), seg_len), dtype=bool)
            for bi, (s_b, e_b) in enumerate(bounds):
                data_mask[bi, :(e_b - s_b)] = True

    mask_gpu = jnp.array(data_mask)
    print(f"  Dataset mask: shape={data_mask.shape}, active frames={data_mask.sum():,}")

    model_params = []
    eval_model_names = [m[0] for m in completed_models]
    num_models = len(eval_model_names)

    print("  Loading parameter matrices (Ab, Q, pi) for all candidate models...")
    for name, max_iter, seed in completed_models:
        ckpt_path = project_dir / name / "checkpoint.h5"
        with h5py.File(ckpt_path, "r") as f:
            snap = f[f"model_snapshots/{max_iter}"]
            Ab = snap["params/Ab"][()]
            Q = snap["params/Q"][()]
            pi = snap["params/pi"][()]

        model_params.append({
            "Ab": jnp.array(Ab),
            "Q": jnp.array(Q),
            "pi": jnp.array(pi)
        })

    # 4. Pairwise Marginal Log-Likelihood Computation
    print("\n" + "=" * 80)
    print(f"  PHASE 3: COMPUTING EXPECTED MARGINAL LIKELIHOOD MATRIX ({num_models}x{num_models})")
    print("=" * 80)
    mlls = np.zeros((num_models, num_models), dtype=np.float64)

    # JIT Warmup
    print("  Warming up JAX JIT compilation on GPU...")
    first_ckpt = project_dir / completed_models[0][0] / "checkpoint.h5"
    with h5py.File(first_ckpt, "r") as f:
        warmup_x = f[f"model_snapshots/{completed_models[0][1]}/states/x"][:10]
    _ = marginal_log_likelihood(
        mask_gpu[:10],
        jnp.array(warmup_x),
        model_params[0]["Ab"],
        model_params[0]["Q"],
        model_params[0]["pi"]
    )
    del warmup_x
    print("  JIT warmup complete.")

    total_pairs = num_models * (num_models - 1)
    pair_count = 0
    t0_eml = time.time()

    # Outer loop streams ONE model's latent states at a time
    for j in range(num_models):
        lat_name, lat_max_iter, lat_seed = completed_models[j]
        ckpt_path = project_dir / lat_name / "checkpoint.h5"
        print(f"\n  [Latent Pool {j+1}/{num_models}] Loading latent trajectories for {lat_name}...", flush=True)
        with h5py.File(ckpt_path, "r") as f:
            x_j = f[f"model_snapshots/{lat_max_iter}/states/x"][()]

        n_seqs = x_j.shape[0]
        batch_size = 50

        for i in range(num_models):
            if i == j:
                continue
            pair_count += 1
            print(f"    [{pair_count}/{total_pairs}] Evaluating mll(model={eval_model_names[i]}, latents={eval_model_names[j]})...", flush=True)

            total_mll = 0.0
            for b_start in range(0, n_seqs, batch_size):
                b_end = min(b_start + batch_size, n_seqs)
                m_sub = mask_gpu[b_start:b_end]
                x_sub = jnp.array(x_j[b_start:b_end])
                ll = marginal_log_likelihood(
                    m_sub, x_sub,
                    model_params[i]["Ab"],
                    model_params[i]["Q"],
                    model_params[i]["pi"]
                )
                total_mll += float(ll)

            mlls[i, j] = total_mll

        del x_j
        import gc
        gc.collect()

    print(f"\nAll cross-likelihood evaluations finished in {time.time() - t0_eml:.1f}s.")

    ea.assert_unchanged(sig_before, ea.stat_signature(ckpt_paths))
    print(f"  [IMMUTABLE] {len(ckpt_paths)} source checkpoints verified unchanged (size + mtime_ns).")

    # 5. Compute EML Scores
    ranking_data = []
    for i in range(num_models):
        other_scores = [mlls[i, j] for j in range(num_models) if i != j]
        eml_mean = float(np.mean(other_scores))
        eml_se = float(np.std(other_scores, ddof=1) / np.sqrt(len(other_scores)))
        name, max_iter, seed = completed_models[i]

        ranking_data.append({
            "model_name": name,
            "seed": seed,
            "eml_score": eml_mean,
            "standard_error": eml_se,
            "iterations": max_iter
        })

    # Sort descending (higher log likelihood is better)
    ranking_data.sort(key=lambda x: x["eml_score"], reverse=True)
    for rank, item in enumerate(ranking_data, 1):
        item["rank"] = rank

    # 6. Save Rankings CSV (tagged per project; never clobber other cohorts' results)
    tag = args.output_tag or project_dir.name.replace("kpms_tandem_cohort_", "")
    csv_paths = [
        output_dir / f"tandem_cohort_eml_model_rankings_{tag}.csv",
        output_dir / f"audits/tandem_cohort_eml_model_rankings_{tag}.csv",
    ]
    plot_png = output_dir / f"tandem_cohort_eml_scores_{tag}.png"
    if not args.overwrite:
        existing = [p for p in csv_paths + [plot_png] if p.exists()]
        if existing:
            alt = time.strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
            tag = f"{tag}_{alt}"
            csv_paths = [
                output_dir / f"tandem_cohort_eml_model_rankings_{tag}.csv",
                output_dir / f"audits/tandem_cohort_eml_model_rankings_{tag}.csv",
            ]
            plot_png = output_dir / f"tandem_cohort_eml_scores_{tag}.png"
            print(f"⚠️  Existing outputs found ({len(existing)}); writing to new tag '{tag}' instead of overwriting.")
    for csv_path in csv_paths:
        with open(csv_path, "w") as f:
            f.write("rank,model_name,seed,eml_score,standard_error,iterations\n")
            for r in ranking_data:
                f.write(f"{r['rank']},{r['model_name']},{r['seed']},{r['eml_score']:.4f},{r['standard_error']:.4f},{r['iterations']}\n")
        print(f"✅ Saved EML rankings to {csv_path}")

    # 7. Generate Barplot
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 6))
    names = [f"{r['model_name']} (Seed {r['seed']})" for r in ranking_data]
    scores = [r["eml_score"] for r in ranking_data]
    errors = [r["standard_error"] for r in ranking_data]

    y_pos = np.arange(len(names))
    ax.barh(y_pos, scores, xerr=errors, align="center", color="#2b5c8f", alpha=0.85, capsize=5)
    ax.set_yticks(y_pos)
    ax.set_yticklabels(names, fontsize=10)
    ax.invert_yaxis()
    ax.set_xlabel("Expected Marginal Log-Likelihood (EML)", fontsize=11)
    ax.set_title("Tandem KPMS Cohort: Model Selection by EML (Higher is Better)", fontsize=12, fontweight="bold")
    plt.tight_layout()

    plt.savefig(plot_png, dpi=200)
    plt.close()
    print(f"✅ Saved EML plot to {plot_png}")

    winner = ranking_data[0]
    print(f"\n🏆 WINNING MODEL: {winner['model_name']} (Seed {winner['seed']})")
    print(f"   EML Score: {winner['eml_score']:.2f} +/- {winner['standard_error']:.2f}")

    send_ntfy(
        f"EML Winner Crowned! 🏆 ({winner['model_name']})",
        f"Rank #1: Seed {winner['seed']}\nEML: {winner['eml_score']:.2f} +/- {winner['standard_error']:.2f}\nRankings saved to CSV and PNG.",
        priority="high",
        tags="trophy,chart_with_upwards_trend"
    )

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
enrich_video_refs_and_analyze_sequences.py

1. Enriches `s.video_refs_df` and `s.tracking_refs_df` across all 112 sessions in
   `sessions_karen_project_w_sylls_tandem_cohort.pkl` with:
   - Bottom camera video paths (/mnt/hdd/karen_project/.../Arena*_BotCamVid_*.avi)
   - Bottom camera tracking paths (bot_h5)
   - Fused 23kp tandem tracking paths (fused_h5)

2. Performs number-agnostic, sequence-intrinsic behavioral dynamic analyses:
   - Bout duration distributions (median, mean, IQR, 95th percentile, KS-test)
   - Self-transition persistence (sticky HMM parameter kappa)
   - First-order transition entropy H(S_{t+1} | S_t) & grammar predictability
   - Transition matrix sparsity & graph density
   - Syllable frequency distribution inequality (Gini coefficient & Zipf alpha)
   - Cumulative vocabulary coverage (50%, 80%, 95% threshold)
"""

import pickle
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import entropy, ks_2samp

REPO_ROOT = Path("/home/fsp585/Desktop/FiberphotometryCode")
sys.path.insert(0, str(REPO_ROOT))

PKL_TANDEM = REPO_ROOT / "syllable_generation/data/sessions_karen_project_w_sylls_tandem_cohort.pkl"
PKL_K240K = REPO_ROOT / "syllable_generation/data/sessions_karen_project_w_sylls_k240k.pkl"
FUSED_DIR = REPO_ROOT / "syllable_generation/multiview_top_bot_experiments/fused_h5_full_cohort"


def compute_sequence_metrics(syll_sequences):
    """
    Computes label-agnostic behavioral sequence statistics across a cohort of syllable sequences.
    """
    all_bouts = []
    transitions = []
    syll_counts = {}

    for seq in syll_sequences:
        valid_seq = seq[np.isfinite(seq) & (seq >= 0)].astype(int)
        if len(valid_seq) < 2:
            continue

        # Count frequencies
        for s in valid_seq:
            syll_counts[s] = syll_counts.get(s, 0) + 1

        # Bout durations
        onsets = np.where(valid_seq[1:] != valid_seq[:-1])[0] + 1
        bout_lens = np.diff(np.concatenate([[0], onsets, [len(valid_seq)]]))
        all_bouts.extend(bout_lens)

        # First-order transitions
        t_from = valid_seq[:-1]
        t_to = valid_seq[1:]
        transitions.append(np.column_stack([t_from, t_to]))

    all_bouts = np.array(all_bouts)
    trans_mat_data = np.vstack(transitions)

    # 1. Bout distribution metrics
    med_bout = np.median(all_bouts)
    mean_bout = np.mean(all_bouts)
    p25, p75 = np.percentile(all_bouts, [25, 75])
    p95 = np.percentile(all_bouts, 95)

    # 2. Self-transition probability (persistence)
    n_total_trans = len(trans_mat_data)
    n_self_trans = np.sum(trans_mat_data[:, 0] == trans_mat_data[:, 1])
    self_trans_prob = n_self_trans / n_total_trans

    # 3. Transition Entropy H(S_{t+1} | S_t)
    u_sylls = np.unique(trans_mat_data)
    k_sylls = len(u_sylls)
    syll_to_idx = {s: i for i, s in enumerate(u_sylls)}

    trans_counts = np.zeros((k_sylls, k_sylls), dtype=float)
    for u, v in trans_mat_data:
        trans_counts[syll_to_idx[u], syll_to_idx[v]] += 1.0

    row_sums = trans_counts.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    row_sums[row_sums == 0] = 1.0
    p_trans = trans_counts / row_sums

    # Marginal P(S_t)
    p_marginal = trans_counts.sum(axis=1) / n_total_trans

    cond_entropy = 0.0
    for i in range(k_sylls):
        row = p_trans[i, :]
        row_pos = row[row > 0]
        if len(row_pos) > 0:
            cond_entropy += p_marginal[i] * entropy(row_pos, base=2)

    marginal_entropy = entropy(p_marginal[p_marginal > 0], base=2)
    predictability = 1.0 - (cond_entropy / marginal_entropy) if marginal_entropy > 0 else 0.0

    # Sparsity: active transitions / possible transitions
    active_trans = np.sum(trans_counts > 0)
    sparsity = active_trans / (k_sylls * k_sylls)

    # 4. Gini Inequality of Syllable Usage
    counts = np.sort(np.array(list(syll_counts.values())))
    n = len(counts)
    index = np.arange(1, n + 1)
    gini = (2.0 * np.sum(index * counts)) / (n * np.sum(counts)) - (n + 1.0) / n

    # Cumulative coverage
    cum_pcts = np.cumsum(counts[::-1]) / np.sum(counts)
    n_50 = np.searchsorted(cum_pcts, 0.50) + 1
    n_80 = np.searchsorted(cum_pcts, 0.80) + 1
    n_95 = np.searchsorted(cum_pcts, 0.95) + 1

    return {
        "all_bouts": all_bouts,
        "n_bouts": len(all_bouts),
        "median_bout_frames": med_bout,
        "median_bout_ms": med_bout / 60.0 * 1000.0,
        "mean_bout_frames": mean_bout,
        "mean_bout_ms": mean_bout / 60.0 * 1000.0,
        "iqr_frames": (p25, p75),
        "p95_frames": p95,
        "self_trans_prob": self_trans_prob,
        "marginal_entropy_bits": marginal_entropy,
        "conditional_entropy_bits": cond_entropy,
        "grammar_predictability_pct": predictability * 100.0,
        "active_syllables": k_sylls,
        "trans_density_pct": sparsity * 100.0,
        "gini_coefficient": gini,
        "sylls_for_50pct": n_50,
        "sylls_for_80pct": n_80,
        "sylls_for_95pct": n_95,
    }

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
evaluate_17kp_vs_21kp_comparison.py
=============================================================================
Comprehensive Evaluation Suite comparing 17kp vs 21kp models on the 10 Pilot Sessions:
  - Arm 1: 17kp baseline (17 dorsal TopCam keypoints)
  - Arm 2: 21kp Static (17 dorsal + 4 static affine ventral paws)
  - Arm 3: 21kp Dynamic (17 dorsal + 4 dynamic paws, bottom anchors removed)

Metrics Evaluated:
  1. Convergence & Syllable Landscape Stability:
     - Consecutive-snapshot Adjusted Rand Index (ARI) and AMI across Gibbs iterations
     - Hamming label-flip rate (% of frames changing syllable between snapshots)
     - Late-stage stabilization metric (average ARI and flip rate across late snapshots >= 100)
  2. Posture & Kinematic Expressiveness:
     - Absolute dorsal variance retained in top 10 PCs (px^2)
     - Absolute paw variance retained in top 10 PCs (px^2)
     - Dorsal vs Paw percentage share in top 10 PCs
  3. Syllable Granularity & Homogeneity:
     - Within-syllable dorsal pose snippet variance explained (R^2)
     - Same-K K-means ceiling ratio (Model R^2 / KMeans R^2)
  4. Temporal Bout Dynamics:
     - Active syllable count (>= 0.1% usage)
     - Median bout duration (ms and frames at 60 fps)
     - Usage distribution entropy
=============================================================================
"""

def load_model_syllables_and_latents(results_path):
    """Loads syllables, latents, and centroids from results.h5."""
    syllables = {}
    latents = {}
    centroids = {}
    with h5py.File(results_path, "r") as f:
        for k in f.keys():
            if isinstance(f[k], h5py.Group) and "syllable" in f[k]:
                syllables[k] = f[k]["syllable"][:]
                if "latent_state" in f[k]:
                    latents[k] = f[k]["latent_state"][:]
